summary: This release marks the initial 2025-03-26 revision of the Model Context Protocol. To users and implementors: note that SDKs will adopt this version at their own pace, and the prior version of the spec may remain in use for an undetermined amount of time. The spec describes how clients and servers perform version negotiation with one another, permitting backwards and forwards compatibility.
body:
This release marks the initial 2025-03-26 revision of the Model Context Protocol.

To users and implementors: note that SDKs will adopt this version at their own pace, and the prior version of the spec may remain in use for an undetermined amount of time. The spec describes how clients and servers perform version negotiation with one another, permitting backwards and forwards compatibility.
summaryZh: 此版本标志着模型上下文协议于 2025 年 3 月 26 日首次修订。致用户和实施者：请注意，SDK 将按照自己的进度采用此版本，并且规范的先前版本可能会在不确定的时间内继续使用。该规范描述了客户端和服务器如何相互执行版本协商，从而允许向后和向前兼容。
